dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Data are based on information in a US-EPA LCA study about LCD and CRT production. The data represent the respective efforts for a 15-inch LCD computer screen, as it is produced in Japan. In 2023, the dataset is updated to reflect the recent electricity consumption share in the production regions. However, the total energy consumption is adjusted after considering efficiency improvement; UUID: 903ca879-a216-3393-8350-bc99e7860964

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Current technology in Japan

# Included processes
This module includes the auxiliaries and energy efforts as well as the related emissions (air/water) and waste amounts for the assembly of a complete LCD screen. Estimations for infrastructure and the overall transport amounts (incl. for the materials in this screen) are included as well.
